name: Pre-Release LocalChatting
summary: Mainly consistency updates/bug fixes, aswell as minor new features.

new_features.title: Story Editor
new_features.description: Each chat now has a story editor, where users can put notes/an overarching story/other important information for the LLM, good for reminders about key facts too.

new_features.title: Ratings Reworked
new_features.description: The old ratings system was added back in v0.2, it was pretty broken and didn't work all that well, tons of fixes + improvements related to ratings actually working for messages.

new_features.title: API Profiles
new_features.description: Now you no longer have to keep everything in a notepad, you can have multiple profiles of API presets, you can quickly hotswap between providers.

new_features.title: Added Tips
new_features.description: When first opening LC, you'll be prompted to enable/disable tips. Tips give some insight on what features do and how to use them, very useful for people inexperienced with LLM terminology.

improvements.title: Streaming Animation
improvements.description: Small animation while waiting for a response, so you have something to stare at while thinking about your life choices.

improvements.title: Expanded delete button
improvements.description: You can now delete all messages below the message you're deleting aswell, and the delete menu just looks better overall.

improvements.title: Better Deletion Menu
improvements.description: Now, when deleting a character, persona, lorebook or chat, the deletion menu shows what you're trying to delete.

improvements.title: Chat/Character Menu Capitalization
improvements.description: The chat/character menu no-longer force-capitalizes the name of the chat/character. It was a bit disorienting to try and rename chats due to it.

improvements.title: Rewrote chat state management
improvements.description: Issues like ratings disappearing and other miscellaneous chat-state issues are now fixed, completely redid the conditions and code for it.

improvements.title: Chat Memory Button
improvements.description: You can no longer go into chat memory on the main menu, that's it.

improvements.title: And then, tons of fixes:
improvements.description: Fixed persona images not loading if AI sent message as persona, Fixed rating/rerolls breaking if you deleted an AI message and the next new message is also an AI message, Fixed custom themes error handling and added a way to cancel custom theme generation, Fixed character images only updating on restart, Fixed recursive scanning for lorebooks, Fixed lorebooks on continuation prompts (Continuing messages).
